name: Fusion Pixel Font 12px proportional (BDF)
license: SIL Open Font License 1.1. setup_project.py copies OFL.txt and LICENSES/ from the archive next to the font.
coverage: Every file covers Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, CJK, kana and hangul; the language files differ in CJK glyph style. Thai and other scripts it lacks are drawn by the engine from a system font at 12 px.
